title: Thirsty for Schnozzberry
description: Thirsty for Schnozzberry — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Chet the Decembrist

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Retrieve a Schnozzberry drink from Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell and then return it to Chet the Decembrist. Chet is in The Whisker's Library - Propaganda Section off the 1st level of Ratsputin's Gulag.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Chet the Decembrist

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Retrieve a Schnozzberry drink from Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell and then return it to Chet the Decembrist. Chet is in The Whisker's Library - Propaganda Section off the 1st level of Ratsputin's Gulag.

Offer:

Good morning, turdbrain! I'm up on these puppies all day long protesting and I don't need some snot nosed sniveling adventurer getting all hippity hoppity.

Now listen here buttwad! You want to make yourself less than worthless? How about you go and get me one of those drinks you tried to poison me with earlier. Oh, and tell your boss Rat'spew'tun 'You're dead meat pilgrim!' Don't give me that slug faced look either. It doesn't take a genius to figure out who you are working for.

Remember, Chet in the Whisker's Library - Propaganda Section wants your sorry butt to get him a Schnozzberry drink!

Turn-in:

Hey, that looks pretty good. Now make yourself one...dillweed!

Objectives:

  • Schnozzberry Drink ×1

Level range: 75–95
